definitions.explanation: Having a quality that overwhelms or frightens others through display of power or dominance.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{威圧的|いあつてき}な{態度|たいど}に{萎縮|いしゅく}した。
examples.english: I felt intimidated by his overbearing attitude.

examples.japanese: {威圧的|いあつてき}な{雰囲気|ふんいき}の{建物|たてもの}だ。
examples.english: It's a building with an intimidating atmosphere.

examples.japanese: {上司|じょうし}が{威圧的|いあつてき}で{話|はな}しかけづらい。
examples.english: My boss is intimidating, so it's hard to approach them.

notes:
FORMATION: {威圧|いあつ} (intimidation, coercion) + {的|てき} (adjectival suffix)

FORMS:
・{威圧的|いあつてき}な＋noun (attributive)
・{威圧的|いあつてき}に＋verb (adverbial)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{威圧的|いあつてき}な{態度|たいど} (intimidating attitude)
・{威圧的|いあつてき}な{雰囲気|ふんいき} (intimidating atmosphere)
・{威圧的|いあつてき}な{視線|しせん} (intimidating gaze)
・{威圧的|いあつてき}に{接|せっ}する (to treat in an intimidating manner)

RELATED TERMS:
・{威圧|いあつ}する - to intimidate
・{高圧的|こうあつてき} - high-handed, overbearing
・{強圧的|きょうあつてき} - coercive, oppressive
